item.description: - Select several meetings in the library (checklist button or ⌘-click) and move them to the Trash with one confirmation. Thanks @VitoSaulle! - **Tell participants** while recording: copies a short message to paste in the call chat, saying you are recording and that they can ask you to stop.

- New installs on macOS 15 transcribe **on your Mac** by default: no account and no API key. The models download during the introduction. If you already use ElevenLabs, nothing changes. - Summaries with Claude Code run with no tools and no MCP servers, in an empty folder: whatever anyone says in a call stays text and is never run as a command. - Updates now come from getoverheard.dev.

- **Apple Intelligence** for summaries and chat: everything on your Mac, no account and nothing to install (macOS 26, Apple Intelligence turned on). - Pick the AI for summaries and chat in **Settings**: Claude Code, Codex or Apple Intelligence. - Updates no longer interrupt you: during a call or a transcription Overheard waits, and shows a dot on the menu bar icon instead. - New option: **Install updates automatically**. - Signed and notarized by Apple: Overheard opens with a double click, no more "Open Anyway". Because the signature changes, macOS asks once more for microphone and system audio access after this update.
